title: What a complete customer reply must include
keywords: reply template insufficient response how to reply customer tone complete answer
body: Greet the customer and name the job (tracking number) you checked.
State the current status and what you found (e.g. driver ETA, POD, reason for delay).
Say exactly what happens next and by when (e.g. 'driver will arrive by 4.30pm', 'we will update you by 6pm').
If a fee or refund applies, state the rule and amount, and get acknowledgement before applying a fee.
Never promise a time, refund or compensation the SOP doesn't allow. Never share internal notes, agent pay or other customers' data.
Close with a clear next step or contact, and log the action in the SG CS Chat.
